Question ID: ANP_U04_L03_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.ANP.NEN.02

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Brain Structures and Function
Stimulus: Brain diagram/model

A student is reviewing the required visual and must explain the first visible structure-function connection. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, identify cerebrum, cerebellum, brainstem, or related region. Then use the required stimulus (Brain diagram/model) to connect the visible evidence to brain structures and function. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ANP.NEN.02 and avoids the common mistake: assigning every brain function to one isolated part.
